$comment: A quest, Adam's to change: an abbot asks what the house holds dearest. Answered well, the road goes by a pledge of piety; answered badly, by a castle held on an island and a delivery of wealth, the cheap road crossed out. Both join at the consecration, a question mark shown ahead, and end at the blessing, shown from the start. Nodes by their ids, the first the one it starts at: a node offers a dialogue of dialogues/ by its name, or holds objectives - delivers a resource, pledges one for so many months, or holds a type of structure, on an island or anywhere - or gives a reward; it is hidden, a question mark, until reached, or shownAhead; and it leads then to a node, or, after a dialogue, to each node by the endings that lead there. Every word and number a placeholder. Taken over on 2026-10-16 from the sample written in the code; the debug panel's Quests section offers it, and /admin/inspect-quests shows and edits it. See decision records 0096 and 0097.
title: The abbot of the isle
